capabilities: Highlight text and attach inline comment cards that align and scroll with the passage
@ mention running Claude Code or Codex sessions, or start a new one, to answer a comment
Track comment delivery status in a mailbox with retry and one-click fixes
Accept or decline suggested edits to the highlighted passage
Track unread replies, resolve threads, and react with emoji
disambiguation: Not an AI chat plugin; the comments work on their own and @ mentions of agent sessions are an optional delivery path.
extras: The plugin never talks to the network; letters and replies are local files. Requires Obsidian 1.8+. Beta builds are distributed via BRAT. The @ mention hook modifies ~/.claude/settings.json (with backup and uninstall). On Linux and Windows terminal-opening buttons copy commands instead.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to leave anchored, threaded comments beside a passage, let alone have people or AI agents reply to them inside the note itself.

relations.evidence: Type @ in a comment to pick a running Claude Code / Codex session on your machine
Codex and Gemini CLI answer in the background, each comment resuming the same session

summary: Inline comment plugin that anchors comment cards to highlighted passages and stores them as CriticMarkup-style plain text in the note, with optional @ mentions of local AI coding sessions.
